name: SAMM/IDTA Pipeline Patterns
context: The DataStack pipeline handles non-CSV data sources from automotive Industry 4.0 standards. Two patterns are demonstrated: SAMM/Catena-X aspect model JSON payloads and IDTA/AAS submodel JSON. Both follow the same principle: create complete metadata → transform with semantic technologies.

pattern_a_samm_catena_x.name: SAMM / Catena-X Aspect Models — Two-Stage Transformation
pattern_a_samm_catena_x.source_format: Flat JSON conforming to Eclipse Tractus-X SAMM aspect models (e.g. io.catenax.material_data:1.0.0)
pattern_a_samm_catena_x.scale_on_live_instance: 26 SAMM mapping datasets on futurecarproduction.materialsdata.space (pattern: samm-mapping-*)

stage_1.name: JSON payload → SAMM-aligned intermediate RDF
stage_1.mechanism: YARRRML mapping with JSONPath iterators traverses flat JSON, produces RDF triples in SAMM/CX namespace with deterministic subject URIs

stage_2.name: SAMM RDF → target ontology (SPARQL CONSTRUCT)
stage_2.mechanism: CONSTRUCT query with VALUES table mapping SAMM properties to target class, QUDT unit, numeric conversion factor, and semantic role. IRI strategy: SHA256 hash-based deterministic IRIs.

sparql_architecture.values_table_maps: 16 SAMM properties (density, Young's modulus, glass transition temperature, etc.) to target class + QUDT unit + conversion factor + semantic role (quality / identifier / information / temporal_interval / measurement_datum)
sparql_architecture.where_clause: Extracts literals from SAMM entities, applies regex numeric parsing, performs unit conversions
sparql_architecture.construct_clause: Emits BFO/OBO-grounded triples: qualities bearing on material entities (obo:RO_0000080), part-whole relations (obo:BFO_0000051), scalar value specifications (OBI numeric/categorical)

pattern_b_idta_aas.name: IDTA / AAS Submodels — Single-Stage YARRRML/RML
pattern_b_idta_aas.source_format: Hierarchical JSON (Asset Administration Shell, IEC 63278) with typed submodel elements: SubmodelElementCollection, Property, identified by idShort
pattern_b_idta_aas.why_single_stage: AAS JSON is already semantically structured with a standardized metamodel vocabulary — a single YARRRML mapping can navigate the hierarchy and map directly to PMDco without an intermediate ontology stage

stage_1.name: AAS submodel JSON → PMDco RDF (direct)
stage_1.mechanism: Multiple JSONPath iterators, each filtering by element type and idShort value, extract individual properties and map directly to PMDco patterns

outputs_pmdco.material: Central material resource typed as physical material object
outputs_pmdco.mechanical_properties: Tensile strength, yield strength, elongation as PMD quality instances with QUDT values in MegaPascals
outputs_pmdco.composition: PMD composition specification with 9 element-specific mass fractions (C, Cr, Mn, Mo, Ni, N, P, Si, S) linked via OBO part-of relations

concrete_example_pa6gf30.name: Cross-Project Use Case (PA6GF30 / Catena-X → PMDco)
concrete_example_pa6gf30.source: Catena-X industrial dataspace via Eclipse Dataspace Connector (EDC)

workflow.name: Retrieve
workflow.description: Pull PA6GF30 JSON payload from Catena-X dataspace participant via EDC

workflow.name: RDF → PMDco
workflow.mechanism: pmdco-mapping-insert.sparql reads from two named graphs in Fuseki: dataGraph (mat:MaterialData instances) + schemaGraph (SAMM aspect model schema)

input_graphs.dataGraph: mat:MaterialData instances with literal property values (from Step 2 joined TTL)
input_graphs.schemaGraph: samm:Property definitions with unit and datatype metadata (SAMM aspect model)

execution_mechanism.tool: pmdco-mapping-insert.html (browser helper stored as CKAN resource)
execution_mechanism.automation: NOT automated — requires human to open HTML in browser, verify endpoint and SPARQL file URL, click Run
execution_mechanism.internal_mechanism: JavaScript fetches .sparql from CKAN, POSTs to Fuseki /$/update with Content-Type: application/sparql-update
execution_mechanism.prerequisites: Both dataGraph and schemaGraph must already be loaded in Fuseki via fuseki_update action

sparql_construct.unit_handling: Regex parsing + conversion factors in VALUES table

two_path_comparison.key_insight: SPARQL CONSTRUCT is the ontology-translation layer. When source data already has an established ontology (SAMM/CX) but target uses a different one (PMDco), CONSTRUCT handles the bridge without touching the original mapping or data.
